data.name: Majibul
data.gender_notes: Majibul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Majibul is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'majja' meaning majesty and 'bul' meaning powerful. This name evokes a sense of strength, wisdom and knowledge. It is a name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a powerful and majestic leader. The name Majibul carries the meaning “Majestic, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Majibul usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Majibul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majibul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
